data.title: Did Gas Vehicle Sales Just Dip Below 50% For The First Time?
data.description: The increasing popularity of electric vehicles is evident in recent sales figures, with reports showing a significant uptick. Despite some discrepancies in the data, there is a clear indication that soaring fuel prices are negatively impacting the demand for gas-powered cars. Speculation suggests that gas vehicle sales may have recently fallen below 50% for the first time, marking a potential shift towards electric vehicles.

data.title: Jobs Report: Soft Hiring Lifts S&P 500, Sinks Rate-Hike Odds; AI Effect?
data.description: The likelihood of an October Federal Reserve rate increase has decreased significantly. Some analysts are attributing this shift to potential impacts from artificial intelligence.

data.title: Houston's Largest Free STEM Family Festival Returns to Sam Houston Park on October 17
data.description: The Energy Day Festival, Houston's premier free family event celebrating science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM), will be back on Saturday, October 17, 2026. Taking place from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. at Sam Houston Park in downtown Houston, the festival is organized by the Consumer Energy Education Foundation (CEEF) in collaboration with the Consumer Energy Alliance (CEA). This festival transforms the park into an expansive outdoor STEM exploration site. data.description: In Palm Springs, California, on October 2, 2026, it was announced that the newly restored interior of Walt Disney's final personal airplane will be open to the public for the first time, not requiring D23 membership.
